narrative.intro: Harris recorded $1.2B in federal contract obligations in FY2026 to date across 11 awards, with an average award size of $107M. Harris obligations are up 27.7% year over year. Yearly obligations show a multiyear increase from $376M in FY21 to $1.2B in FY26. Harris recorded $918M in FY25 and $459M in FY24, with intermediate values of $386M in FY23 and $313M in FY22. The current-year total is a fiscal year to date figure and the award-count and average-award figures reflect that partial period. This profile indicates larger, fewer awards in the current year compared with prior years, given the combination of $1.2B total obligations and an average award size of $107M. Contract values in the largest-awards and expiring-contracts tables are total contract values rather than obligations. Readers should treat the FY2026 totals as partial because the fiscal year is not complete.

sections.heading: How has Harris' federal contracting trended recently?
sections.body: Harris obligations are up 27.7% year over year. Harris obligations rose from $918M in FY25 to $1.2B in FY26. Harris showed a multiyear climb from $376M in FY21 through $1.2B in FY26, with dips in FY22 and rebounds in FY23 and FY24.
